$3635415 = (945)(3847)$ is a counterexample. I suspect that for any odd abundant $A$, $Ap$ where $p$ is a large prime compared to $\sigma(A)$ will be a counterexample. I also suspect that if $Ap^k$ for $p$ very large compared to $\sigma(A)$ will provide counterexamples.

I also suspect that your conjecture is true if $n$ is primitive non-deficient in the sense that $n$ has no perfect or abundant divisors.
